auditor: Independent auditor (NYC special education hearing orders)
title: Independent Auditor's Post Corrective Action January 2026 Limited Review
plain_title: Special education orders: 36% of services, 13% of payments on time
what_they_audited: A one-month limited review by the court-appointed independent auditor, Guidehouse, measuring whether the New York City Department of Education (DOE) carried out orders issued by Impartial Hearing Officers in special education cases on time. It covers orders issued between November 27 and December 27, 2025 whose individual tasks, called Action Items, were finally due in January 2026.
background: Advocates for Children of New York (AFC) and the law firm Milbank filed the class action L.V. v. D.O.E. in 2003 on behalf of parents of special needs children who won hearing orders against the DOE but did not get them carried out fully and on time. A 2007 Stipulation and Agreement of Settlement requires an independent auditor to report on how much of what hearing officers order is Timely Implemented, meaning done within the time the order sets or within 35 days if it sets none.

findings.plain: The department implemented on time 12.8% of payment orders, 11.7% of payment action items, 36.4% of service orders and 33.4% of service action items in the January 2026 window.

findings.plain: Those rates were a large jump from recent full quarters. Across the last eight quarterly reports the department had averaged 3.0% of payment orders and 8.7% of service orders on time.
findings.quote: average, 3.0% of Payment Orders, 3.2% of Payment Actions, 8.7% of Service Orders

findings.plain: Even with the improvement, the auditor stressed that on-time performance stayed low, below 13% for payments and below 37% for services.

compliance_note: On-time compliance rose sharply compared with the department's final quarterly reports, but the auditor noted it stayed below 13% for payments and below 37% for services, meaning most hearing orders in the month reviewed were still not carried out on time.
